NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Performance Review Policy
 Document ID
NT-HR-008
Department
Human Resources
Version
1.5
Effective Date
01 April 2025
1. Review Cycle
NovaTech runs two review cycles each year: the mid-year review in October and the annual review
in April. The performance year runs from April to March. Goals must be set within the first 30 days
of the performance year.
2. Rating Scale
Employees are rated on a 5-point scale: 1 - Needs Improvement, 2 - Partially Meets Expectations,
3 - Meets Expectations, 4 - Exceeds Expectations, 5 - Outstanding. Ratings are decided after a
calibration meeting of department heads to keep ratings fair across teams.
3. 360-Degree Feedback
Employees at Senior Manager level and above receive 360-degree feedback from at least 5 peers,
direct reports and stakeholders. Feedback is anonymous and is shared in summarised form.
4. Salary Increments
The annual increment depends on the rating. A rating of 3 gives a typical increment of 8 percent, a
rating of 4 gives 12 percent, and a rating of 5 gives 15 percent. Employees with a rating of 1 or 2
are not eligible for an increment. Increments take effect from 1 May.
5. Performance Improvement Plan
Employees rated 1 are placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) of 60 days. The manager
and HR review progress every 2 weeks. If the targets are not met by the end of the PIP, the
employee may be exited as per company policy.
6. Promotions
Promotions are considered once a year in April. An employee must have at least 18 months in the
current role and a rating of 4 or above in the last review cycle to be eligible.
